rows.label: tlk502101_msg0001
rows.name:
Mooo... Repairing Goldmund is hard
work, mooo.

rows.label: tlk502101_msg0002
rows.name:
It's an old ship, so no matter how
much I repair it, it keeps breaking,
mo.

rows.label: tlk502101_msg0003
rows.name:
It's definitely not because Tondon is
bad at repairs, mo.

rows.label: tlk502101_msg0004
rows.name:
But nobody believes me. It just sounds
like an excuse, the work never ends,
and I'm tired, mooo.

rows.label: tlk502101_msg0005
rows.name:
Yes, I'm sure it's hard work.
But it's very important!

rows.label: tlk502101_msg0008
rows.name:
It's wooden, but I can tell how
carefully it's been used. I think
that's wonderful.

rows.label: tlk502101_msg0011
rows.name:
Thanks to Hotaru-chan's encouragement,
my motivation is gushing out, mo!

rows.label: tlk502101_msg0012
rows.name:
I'll work hard repairing the walls,
mooo!

rows.label: tlk502101_msg0013
rows.name:
I can't give you anything great, but
this is a present for Hotaru-chan, mo!
